answer: Voting power mirrors paid, recent verification work, not identity count. Reputation is like opal: bright when earned, decaying unless renewed each epoch by a verified check costing real compute. Fresh or dormant personas start near zero, so bulk-registering aliases is worthless. To make a fake identity useful an attacker must fund its renewal bond for many consecutive epochs, priced in a scarce unit like copper, and renewal slots are auctioned per operator - so n sybils cost n full renewal streams plus auction competition, rising super-linearly, while honest agents renew cheaply.
